scope: Independent consumer review of @ai-matrx/content-ir 0.19.11 to 0.19.13 and @ai-matrx/records 0.58.25 to 0.58.26 after release-stabilization-035 stopped at package freshness. No install, build, tests, or browser run in this lane.
source_basis: The aidream checkout's package.json files name 0.19.13 and 0.58.26; its newer release tags were not present locally. Compared the available older tags to aidream HEAD 808a5873bb04b84f60676d5a7f913966f3cb11d5 and checked key changes in the installed packages.

contentIr.actualChange: The /source API adds and exports isHtmlBlockTagName(name), a CommonMark block-tag name classifier. GFM and source-island test vectors expand. The installed source bundle and declaration export the helper. Existing callable signatures in the source diff are unchanged.
contentIr.changelogAccuracy: Both 0.19.12 and 0.19.13 claim metadata-only republish. The older tag-to-matching-source diff has a real additive implementation/export change; no required consumer action is stated.
contentIr.extensionUse: Extension source imports @ai-matrx/content-ir/core and /wire for envelope, partial-kind, and metadata validation. It has no /source import or call to isHtmlBlockTagName or the table helpers. Content-ir-react and kit resolve the updated content-ir transitively in the lockfile.
contentIr.consumerAction: None required for current extension call sites.

records.actualChange: Regenerated store.generated.ts reflects seven additional live door names, updated refusal-source lists, and entity-token changes. Installed /core includes entries such as dashboard_restore and where_lists_live. No hand-written core client API changed in the source diff.
records.changelogAccuracy: 0.58.26 claims docs/metadata drift. The generated runtime store catalog changed; it is read by the package's door availability gate, so this is a real data/behavior update, though it does not alter extension call signatures.
records.extensionUse: Extension constructs a RecordsClient through @ai-matrx/records/core and calls existing table/record operations. It does not import STORE_DOORS, STORE_REFUSAL_CODES, ENTITY_TOKENS, or the new door names directly.
records.consumerAction: None required for current extension call sites. Existing door checks should continue to resolve; root verification still owns runtime evidence.

refresh_observed.lockfileDelta: Content-ir 0.19.11 to 0.19.13 and records 0.58.25 to 0.58.26, including content-ir transitive references. package.json already declares latest.

verdict: NO_REQUIRED_EXTENSION_SOURCE_ADOPTION. Installed packages and source were inspected, but package gate, compile, tests, browser behavior, and release retry are root-owned and not verified in this lane.
